claims.object_text: structural component of the cohesin complex
claims.quote: The SMC1A gene, which encodes a structural component of the cohesin complex is also located on the X chromosome.
Missense variants and small in-frame deletions of SMC1A cause approximately 5% of Cornelia de Lange Syndrome (CdLS).
All 10 mutations identified are predicted to result in premature truncation of the SMC1A protein.

claims.object_text: severe epilepsy phenotype with cluster seizures in females
claims.quote: Truncation mutations in SMC1A cause a severe epilepsy phenotype with cluster seizures in females.

claims.object_text: onset of epileptic seizures between <4 weeks and 28 months of age
claims.quote: They presented with onset of epileptic seizures between <4 weeks and 28 months of age.

claims.object_text: seizure clusters associated with developmental regression
claims.quote: Seizure clusters were associated with developmental regression.
Moderate or severe developmental impairment was apparent in all cases.
These mutations are likely to be nonviable in males.
